connector.name: Whisper Transcribe
connector.registryDescription: Transcribe audio locally with faster-whisper or through the OpenAI Whisper API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package whisper-transcribe-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zahirinatzuke account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the cloud backend and optional GPT post-processing.

env.name: WHISPER_MODEL
env.description: Default faster-whisper model size when using the local backend.
